temporal_evidence.interpretation: The overlay is not a 2020-2025-only rescue because it is also slightly positive vs base in 1975-1984, but neither high-inflation era shows material value against the exposure-matched static control.

leave_one_era_out.note: Omitting GFC/QE or COVID/higher-rate periods makes overlay-vs-base CAGR negative; matched-static residual also changes sign under some era omissions.

redirect_sensitivity_diagnostic_only.interpretation: Larger redirect produces a slightly larger return effect, but sensitivities are diagnostic only and do not change the primary verdict.

verdict_exclusions.robust_inflation_conditioned_switching_v: Rejected because the primary overlay adds only ~2.7bp CAGR versus the unchanged base policy, has no max-drawdown improvement, loses Sharpe and drawdown quality versus matched static, and is not robust to episode/era leaveouts.
verdict_exclusions.historical_risk_management_value_only: Rejected because max drawdown is unchanged versus base and materially worse than the matched static control; there is no non-fragile downside improvement.
verdict_exclusions.recent_era_rescue_only: Rejected because the overlay is also slightly positive versus base in 1975-1984; the problem is lack of material/robust value, not exclusively recent concentration.
verdict_exclusions.allocation_mix_only_no_switching_value: Not selected because the overlay does not even add a material benefit versus the base policy; the more basic conclusion is that the tested overlay itself is economically small.
verdict_exclusions.inconclusive_insufficient_evidence: Not selected because 51 years, 16 active years, the early high-inflation era, recent high-inflation era, leave-one-era-out and episode tests are sufficient to conclude the preregistered primary overlay lacks material value.

interpretation: Phase 2 structural evidence that high absolute inflation changes Treasury-vs-cash payoff remains valid.
Phase 3 shows that a crude binary >=4% rule plus 50% Treasury-sleeve haircut does not translate that structure into material portfolio value.
This is evidence against this overlay design, not against HMRA/V6.6 and not against the Phase 2 inflation-regime interaction.
Do not tune the 4% threshold, redirect fraction, or #89 base matrix to rescue Issue #95.
A future study would need a new preregistered mechanism rather than parameter rescue.
